dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: It burns the Kresnik Kristall. That's why it's called the Kresnik's Torch.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: A lot of people assume the ore was named after the Torch, but if you stop and think about it, the ore must have existed first, right? Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: The ore is brought in by rail from Novokitezhgrad.
